start_here: Say to your AI: "Show me the Panes and Feel settings". It runs tool:read-pane-and-feel-settings and answers the pane defaults, the settings rows a person edits, and each moment with the feel it plays on touch, sound and motion.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it reads the pane-sizes file and the feel rows that tools/feel owns, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show me the Panes and Feel settings".
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run and tool tool:read-pane-and-feel-settings with an empty input.

3. Read the answer: panes.defaults holds each pane's starting size, panes.sections lists the settings rows, and feel.moments lists each moment with its feel; a moment that names an undefined feel makes the answer fail, not draw.

worked_examples.title: The Panes and Feel settings as the DATA states them
worked_examples.ask: Show me the Panes and Feel settings
worked_examples.given: No input: the pane sizes and the feel rows are read from their own files.
